name: RadBench
description: RadBench is a comprehensive evaluation benchmark for radiology foundation models, covering five tasks including modality recognition, disease diagnosis, visual question answering, report generation, and rationale diagnosis to assess model capabilities in clinical applications.
reputation: A recent comprehensive radiology benchmark that is gaining attention for evaluating foundation models across multiple clinically relevant tasks.
notes: Includes multiple radiology tasks and modalities; dataset MedMD and RadMD are also introduced; benchmark aims to evaluate foundation models in practical clinical problems.
